title: UI feedback receipt completed: later source, lifecycle and coverage corrections
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full cumulative audit review; proposals and historical source/UI coverage qualified against later owners
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full cumulative review now covers original1–1174 and all appended B562–B564 notes through1219. B562–B564 actually read1–925; this tranche read926–1174 and1175–1219. The original1174-line prefix SHA256 d6c41707d7c81ed6fd375ed5307a76865bb445a7c22a7befeb0c0dc30da2b8e4 matches B562 before accepting cumulative coverage. Earlier folds retain their narrower ranges. No linked screenshots, transcript, source novel, private artifacts, current runtime or underlying tests were newly opened or executed by this audit reading.

F2: MC127–MC134 preserve acquired method versus usable instruction, actual research trials versus understanding, local body/source/environment compatibility, functional older tools versus UI archiving or relinquishment, multi-method suppliers and plan intention versus committed equipment/control/reservations. Failed deduction is not negative insight XP; lower output is not loss of ownership; rank does not delete a still-functional tool. Institutional standing is not a universal favor bar or access to private stock. Discovery can expose newly known actions without rewriting old history or presenting an unwired source mechanic as implemented. AD51 qualifies the old two-consumer-before-sharing prerequisite.

F3: MC135–MC145 preserve the recorded top-down screen/engine direction, workroom/provider and current notebook versus historical report, supervised activity versus learned faculty, private versus filed/published reports, current city/era/stock/currency and alternative means toward the actual objective. Historic finite planner counts, observed allowance percentages, chat replies and dispatches grant no new workers, messages or budgets. Separate world plans can share integration without one chat per checkbox. MC146–MC153 retain ability revisions/borrowed grants, current versus earlier memories, intended recipient/actual reply/verified identity, exact affected body or link and passive handling versus deliberate activation. WA54–WA57 are scoped trace/pressure/exception/ownership references, not universal world canon; bounded comparison is not complete coverage of either source.

F4: MC154–MC168 preserve repair structure versus restored function, local qualification/community context and practical counterexample, not an inverse universal repair/destruction law. A cited source member ordinal can differ from its displayed chapter. Existing source supplements avoid repeating the whole MC1–MC134 scan. LR2 questions and MD1–MD9 report temporary reach/control, room shutdown versus design, early relay versus later conduit and shared fuel versus private experience. They do not supply missing room energy/volume laws. D&D suppression/concentration rules and distinct SRD revisions remain local; a self-suppression cycle does not imply flicker odds, infinite processing or an exploit nerf. Historical source visitation pause differs from the world's loop. Return amendments remain proposed unless adopted by current authority.

F5: MC169–MC173 explicitly reject exhaustive protagonist/UI coverage. LOTM maps, partial HP volumes, retained MoL visitor material and a D&D profile have different scope. Generic family labels do not cover every action; mapped controls and historical reachability are not an ordered native replay. Admission must precede aggregate counts/search/accessibility labels, but this is a proposed leak risk, not a freshly observed defect. Support loss needs its actual phase, payer, product, evidence and obligation, not universal refunds or erased learning. Lead/canon constraints, world eligibility and absent implementation differ; no invented in-world excuse or mode toggle follows. Keep identified, UI-specified, engine-connected and journey-verified states separate in existing owners.

F6: MC174–MC179 retain exact historical join denominators, scene/actor distinctions and proposed journey/control gaps. B553's later full review of LOTM_SITUATION_UI_COVERAGE supersedes the old337 opening-coverage interpretation as unsafe; later RC2/RC3 and current campaign owners qualify the older56-group/4478-paragraph/39-qualified snapshot. Neither old zero established journeys nor its counts describes all current runtime. The two MC179 headings are follow-through under one preserved code, not new mechanics to renumber. GP16–GP20/DL43 proposals and injected host seams do not prove durable caller atomicity, completed journeys or authorization to carry living passengers as item baggage. Old L1/L2b ordering, allowance-stop and handoff instructions are history, not current blockers or a new dispatch. Current PROJECT, AD16/AD36/AD42/AD43/AD51 and exact later receipts govern. Screenshot/checksum and target-count claims remain attributed evidence of their historical slice, not fresh visual/accessibility/human acceptance. No gameplay, worker, private save, acquisition, migration, deletion, commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: Actual cumulative reads original1–925 in B562–B564, new926–1174 plus appended1175–1219; original prefix SHA matches B562. Reading report text does not inspect linked source/runtime/images.
reviews.reopen: Use the owning UI/source/continuation records and later exact receipts when selecting an authorized bounded implementation; no reopening historical worker or budget instructions.
